title: task-tree verification
description: Editor aid for verification/<root-id>.json; the file name is the root task whose subtree the records cover. The task-tree compiler is the authority: it also checks that tasks exist in this root task, that each context names exactly the task's dimensions and a state it has there, that checks are declared and required by the task's type, that timestamps are real dates, and that records are unique, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

records.description: At most one record per task, context and check; a re-check replaces the record.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.

task.description: Id of a typed task in this file's root task.

context.description: The task's state, when it has states, and a value for every dimension that applies to it.

check.description: A check the task's type requires.

by.description: Who verified it: a person or an agent.

at.description: ISO 8601 date and time with a time zone.

evidence.description: Where the evidence is, such as a screenshot path or URL.
